mapper.insert: insert into business_event( event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_no, idempotency_key, payload, event_status, retry_count, create_by, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{aggregateNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payload}, #{eventStatus}, #{retryCount}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.select: select event_id eventId, event_type eventType, aggregate_type aggregateType, aggregate_id aggregateId, aggregate_no aggregateNo, idempotency_key idempotencyKey, payload, event_status eventStatus, retry_count retryCount, next_retry_time nextRetryTime, create_by createBy from business_event where event_status in ('PENDING', 'FAILED') and retry_count < 10 and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= sysdate()) order by event_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update business_event set event_status='PROCESSING', update_time=sysdate() where event_id=#{eventId} and event_status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and retry_count < 10 and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= sysdate())
update business_event set event_status='PROCESSED', processed_time=sysdate(), update_time=sysdate() where event_id=#{eventId} and event_status in ('PENDING','FAILED','PROCESSING')

update business_event set event_status=case when retry_count+1 >= 10 then 'DEAD' else 'FAILED' end, retry_count=retry_count+1, next_retry_time=case when retry_count+1 >= 10 then null else date_add(sysdate(), interval least(retry_count+1, 10) minute) end, error_message=#{errorMessage}, update_time=sysdate() where event_id=#{eventId} and event_status='PROCESSING'
update business_event set event_status='PENDING', retry_count=0, next_retry_time=null, processed_time=null, error_message=null, update_time=sysdate() where event_id=#{eventId} and event_status='DEAD'
